mentions.name: Slopshare
mentions.description: A Linux-kernel-like operating environment implemented in JavaScript that runs in the browser, where each program executes as WASM. The whole system is bootstrapped from a C/C++ compiler compiled from source with a new target, and it has evolved into something like Docker for WASM. It can also run coding agents sandboxed inside the browser with HTTP policies and backend-managed skills/extensions, compiling Codex from source and running other agents (e.g. pi agent and the old Node-based CC) on a custom JavaScript runtime built on QuickJS.
